date_note: Date is Dailysecu's publication day; the intrusion date is not stated.
title: Savings bank staff details leak after hack of KG Edu One training management site
summary: Dailysecu reports that an education management site run by KG Edu One for savings banks was hacked. Leaked data were savings bank names, employee positions and names. The article says it is not confirmed that customer financial data leaked, and the intrusion date, route and number affected are not disclosed. It warns of voice phishing and smishing posing as bank staff.
plain: A training-management site run for savings banks in South Korea was hacked, leaking staff names, positions and bank names. Customer financial data leaks have not been confirmed.
exec: A supplier's training site exposed bank employee identities, which can fuel impersonation scams against customers and staff.
action: Savings bank customers: do not give account passwords, OTPs or authentication numbers to callers or texts claiming to be bank staff; verify through official channels.

validation.note: Only Dailysecu read; it cites savings banks' public notices, which were not read. Number of banks and staff, and the date, not stated.

review.note: Dailysecu says the customer data leak is not confirmed, not that banks have not confirmed it; summary fixed
